summary: KKR Enhanced US Direct Lending Fund-L Inc. filed an 8-K solely to declare a routine dividend of $8.41 per share payable August 31, 2026 to shareholders of record July 31, 2026. No special situation is involved; the filing is an ordinary current report on other events. The dividend declaration does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, capital return program, or other transformative corporate event. As a business development company, such distributions are standard practice. No deal terms, advisors, or strategic actions were disclosed. The filing is purely informational and does not warrant classification as a special situation.
